monsters.title: Stream Monsters · Portrait Arcade Rally
monsters.heroTitle: One gift. One egg. One monster forever.
monsters.heroCopy: The fair portrait-first live collecting game: gifts speed up the show, never combat strength. All 72 furry forms are bundled and broadcast-ready.
monsters.liveCenterCopy: See every essential live, GCCE, OBS, arena, renderer and audio state at a glance.
monsters.elementalHourGenericExplanation: Elemental Hour shortens matching egg hatch time by 30 seconds and grants +10 Hype. It never changes combat stats or hatch quality.
monsters.repairEggsCopy: Preview eggs whose ready or expiry transition is overdue. No egg is changed during preview.
monsters.repairEggsConfirm: I reviewed the preview and want to reconcile these eggs.
monsters.repairPreviewPrompt: Run a preview to inspect aggregate counts.
monsters.repairMatchesCopy: Preview timed-out matches that are still open. Active matches inside the grace period are not candidates.
monsters.repairMatchesConfirm: I reviewed the preview and want to cancel these stale matches.
monsters.gameplayCopy: Set incubation, spoil time, season length, missions and fairness rules in one place.
monsters.fairnessGifts: Gifts buy speed and show effects, never combat strength.
monsters.fairnessXp: Monster XP is awarded after every legitimate battle.
monsters.fairnessPermanent: Collection, levels, stats and evolutions remain permanent.
monsters.communityMomentum: Hype, Heart Chains, quests and the stream mission reward playing together.
monsters.giftsChatCopy: Search the complete catalog, choose Random or Boost mappings and configure conflict-free aliases.
monsters.aliasCopy: Use several aliases per action. Language variants can be enabled individually.
monsters.overlayLanguagesCopy: Critical prompts rotate through one or two selected languages without changing the app language.
monsters.commandOutcomeEggs: Shows eggs, countdowns, and queue positions.
monsters.commandOutcomeAdopt: Claims an available free egg only.
monsters.commandOutcomeMonsters: Shows the monster collection with rotation.
monsters.commandOutcomeMonster: Opens a large monster card with stats.
monsters.commandOutcomeChoose: Selects a monster for collection or Arena.
monsters.commandOutcomeBattle: Searches for a fair Arena opponent.
monsters.commandOutcomeLeavebattle: Leaves matchmaking or a reserved battle.
monsters.commandOutcomeRank: Shows Arena Rating and Collector Score.
monsters.commandOutcomeMonstershelp: Shows relevant controls in the overlay only.
monsters.overlayStudioCopy: Design portrait and landscape separately, verify safe zones and test every live scene.
monsters.previewNormalHelp: Avatar, music, likes, egg shelf and XP sources remain visible during normal play.
monsters.previewBattleHelp: The Stream Monsters source covers the upper 74%; the lower 26% stays clear for TikTok chat.
monsters.portraitBattlePreviewHelp: Stream Monsters stays inside the bounded violet portrait arena; the external Likebar remains reserved and the egg shelf uses the lower exception lane.
monsters.obsSourceOrderTitle: OBS source order for battle takeover
monsters.obsSourceOrderIntro: Put these sources in this order from top to bottom:
monsters.obsExternalSourcesWarning: Stream Monsters cannot hide another OBS source with CSS. Keep those sources below the takeover, or disable them in your battle scene.
monsters.assetLibraryCopy: Verify all 24 templates and 72 evolution forms with bundled asset integrity.
monsters.assetEmergencyCopy: Used only when a bundled furry asset is missing or damaged.
monsters.evolutionIntegrityCopy: Stages II and III add fixed elemental stats and unlock role-specific skill upgrades.
monsters.communitySeasonsCopy: Find viewer collections and track Arena Rating separately from Collector Score.
monsters.readinessCopy: Four clear checks and the arena is ready to broadcast.
monsters.rulesDynamic: {duration} incubation · active prefix {prefix} · 24-hour egg expiry · interactive A/B/C skill arena under Rules v8.
monsters.giftsCopy: The complete TikTok catalog is the source. Only enabled gifts trigger Stream Monsters actions.
monsters.chooseGift: Choose a gift in the catalog.
monsters.collectionsCopy: Eggs, monsters, selection, level and achievements for one viewer at a glance.
monsters.viewerSummaryEmpty: Rank, selection and achievements appear after searching.
monsters.viewerEmpty: Choose a viewer to see eggs and monsters.
monsters.leagueCopy: The collection remains. Only season points and rank restart after 28 days.

monsters.portraitArenaVariantHelp: Choose how both fighters are arranged inside the bounded portrait arena. The Likebar remains external and reserved.

monsters.skillCopyEmberAttack: A fierce strike that leaves a brief burn.
monsters.skillCopyEmberDefense: Raises a fiery shield that retaliates once.
monsters.skillCopyEmberSpecial: Unleashes a heavy blaze and restores resolve.
monsters.skillCopyTideAttack: A flowing hit that weakens the next attack.
monsters.skillCopyTideDefense: Wraps the fighter in mist, shield and healing.
monsters.skillCopyTideSpecial: A restorative wave that damages and heals.
monsters.skillCopyGroveAttack: A thorny strike that punishes one counter-hit.
monsters.skillCopyGroveDefense: Builds the strongest pure shield in the arena.
monsters.skillCopyGroveSpecial: Combines damage, protection and steady healing.
monsters.skillCopyGaleAttack: Dashes through the target with two visible hits.
monsters.skillCopyGaleDefense: Creates a light shield and a chance to evade.
monsters.skillCopyGaleSpecial: Crosses the arena in a cinematic three-hit rush.
monsters.skillCopyVoltAttack: Cuts through part of the target shield.
monsters.skillCopyVoltDefense: Stores charge in a shield that reflects once.
monsters.skillCopyLunarAttack: A measured strike that restores a little health.
monsters.skillCopyLunarDefense: Raises a veil and dims the next enemy attack.
monsters.skillCopyLunarSpecial: Drains life from the target in a lunar burst.
